items.title: The Planet of The Apes
items.inspection: Caesar standing in the ape village (Dawn of the Planet of the Apes still); clean, no text, no watermark, no logo. Source 2202x1152.

items.title: The Twilight Zone
items.inspection: Rod Serling close-up against the iconic black-and-white spiral; clean, no text, no watermark. Refined-query pick after the first candidate turned out to be a Back to the Future still. Source 1600x900.

items.title: The Witcher
items.inspection: Geralt standing in a misty medieval town street; clean, no text, no watermark. Source 1500x1000.

items.title: Twisted Metal
items.inspection: Key art: John Doe and Quiet in front of Sweet Tooth in his ice-cream truck under pink smoke; clean, no text, no watermark. Source 1650x825.

items.title: Vikings
items.inspection: Ragnar, Lagertha and warriors wading ashore through blood-red water; clean, no text, no watermark. Fallback after the first candidate carried a large VIKINGS title logo. Source 1200x675.

items.title: Wipeout
items.inspection: Official press still: hosts and two contestants celebrating on the winner's platform on the course; no overlaid text or watermark. Note: giant yellow W letters are in-scene set dressing, and a small WIPEOUT wordmark is on one contestant's vest. Source 1584x1056.

items.title: X-Men
items.inspection: Wolverine, Jean Grey and Mystique amid a ruined bridge battle; clean, no text, no watermark. Source 2560x1440.

items.title: Marvel
items.inspection: Avengers: Endgame final-battle still — armies pouring through Doctor Strange's portals; clean, no text, no watermark. Chose the portals battle rather than the obvious Avengers group shot. Source 1920x1080.

items.title: Solar Opposites and Rick and Morty
items.inspection: Solar Opposites alien family (Korvo, Terry, Yumyulack, Jesse) together at sunset in the neighbourhood; clean, no text, no watermark. Fallback after the first candidate had SOLD/FOR SALE signs and a TV MA badge. Source 1100x619.

items.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street - The Baliscon Cuts
items.inspection: Freddy Krueger silhouetted with arms outstretched in a dark blue alley (1984 film); clean, no text, no watermark. NOTE: source is only 600x375, so the 1280x720 output is a ~2.1x upscale and will look softer than the others. Source 600x375.

items.title: Alien Series
items.inspection: Alien (1979): the Nostromo crew in spacesuits discovering the derelict ship and the Space Jockey; clean, no text, no watermark. Fallback after the first candidate had a green ALIEN title logo. Source 1920x1080.

items.title: Ash vs Evil Dead
items.inspection: Ash with his chainsaw at a night fairground; no overlaid text or watermark. Note: SMASH/M lettering on the shipping containers behind him is in-scene set painting, not an overlay. Source 920x613.

items.title: Backrooms
items.inspection: Classic Backrooms liminal space: empty yellow-wallpapered rooms, fluorescent ceiling lights, yellow carpet; clean, no text, no watermark. Source 2560x1440.

items.title: Batman Noir
items.inspection: The Batman (2022): Batman silhouetted in profile against a dusk Gotham skyline; clean, no text, no watermark. NOTE: source had baked-in black letterbox bars; bars were trimmed before the 16:9 center-crop so the output is full-frame. Source 3840x2160; letterbox bars trimmed (276-1884 of 2160px)

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
items.inspection: Genuine anime still: EVA-01 looming in its cage above Shinji, Ritsuko and Misato on the gantry; clean, no legible text (tiny in-scene Japanese signs only). Fallback chosen over a painted fan-art wallpaper; 2.4:1 source, center crop keeps EVA-01. Source 1200x500.

items.title: Robocop Series
items.inspection: Real RoboCop (1987) film screenshot: RoboCop walking through water at the steel mill, gun raised; clean, no text, no watermark. Fallback chosen over the first candidate, which was a painted illustration rather than a still. Source 1118x603.
